what: supplement 6 to the night-1 pre-registration: C4, the time of each stage with the embedder, the reranker and the answer model all on the card, measured after the answer model is ready
why: supplement 5's four configurations spilled only while the answer model was starting; after it was ready the three services stayed on the card (about 21.9 GB, shared 549-569 MiB) and answered. This cell times that steady state. It is not a fifth configuration: it is configuration 1 of supplement 5

answer_model.setting: NIM_MAX_MODEL_LEN 16384, --max-num-seqs 26, NIM_KVCACHE_PERCENT 0.65, --reasoning-parser nemotron_v3; the Blueprint's nims.yaml environment (as supplement 5)

embedder.setting: fp16 (NIM_ENGINE_PRECISION=fp16), the volume's deviation 1: the same vector space as the HotpotQA index, so the passages found are the right ones (supplement 5's memory cells used the Blueprint's default embedder and stay as they are)

configuration.order: embedder, reranker, answer model; 60 s after the answer model is ready before anything is timed

alone_runs.new: the n3 embedder alone, and the answer model alone at the configuration's setting: S (steady Windows shared usage, spill_judge.steady_shared) and D (card delta)
alone_runs.kept: the reranker's alone run of supplement 5 (2026-10-21 03:5x)
alone_runs.embedder_alone_times: while the n3 embedder is alone: its query calls for the same 200 questions at c = 1 (stage_alone_timing.py embed), so the not-coresident table has the same embedder

spill_after_ready.window: the Windows counter samples from 30 samples (60 s) after the answer model's ready sample to the end of the timing runs
spill_after_ready.rule: spilled_after_ready if any sample of the window rises above S_embed + S_rank + S_llm + 512 MiB
spill_after_ready.branch: the times are measured either way; if it holds, every file and figure is marked coresident_spilled

stages.program: scripts/c4_timing.py (unchanged) through the RAG server 2.6.0 with compose_es/c4_n3.env
stages.how: POST /v1/generate, use_knowledge_base true, collection hotpotqa_whole, every other setting the default; per question the server's own metrics of its last stream chunk (retrieval_time_ms = query embedding + vector search, context_reranker_time_ms, llm_ttft_ms, rag_ttft_ms, llm_generation_time_ms) copied as sent, and in the client the whole call and the first answer text
stages.questions: the 200 of the C3 sample (seed 20261018), not filtered
stages.compare: beside the not-coresident table (each service alone, the same 200 questions): how much each stage slows down on the shared card
stages.branch: if the answer model refuses requests at c = 4 (sequence limit), that is recorded as it is; no setting is changed

not_done: no smaller ratio, no other configuration (the owner's rule)
stop: the owner gave the card until 20:30 on 2026-10-21
